messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [INCIDENT] High error rate: funcall parser failures for tenant northleaf in VPC eu-west-1. Metric: funcall_parse_error_rate = 0.47 (5m). Root error: \"parser: unexpected end of input\". Pager routed to #eng-oncall.

sara: oncall here — looking. thanks for the ping. starting triage: grabbing recent logs and metrics.

sara: logs show a lot of truncated payloads. sample from northleaf-parser: ```
2026-03-12T14:05:23Z ERROR parser.go:217 tenant=northleaf request_id=abc123 error=\"unexpected end of input\" raw_payload=\"{\"tool\": \"getAccount\", \"args\": {\"account_id\": \"A12\"}---TRUNCATED---\"```

mike: do we know if this started after a deploy? I noticed a parser config push earlier today that changed paging delimiter handling (dev/infra#342). could be delimiter mismatch with customer messages that include embedded newlines.

jess: I can roll parser back or flip routing for northleaf to the legacy parser. which would be less risky?

sara: quick impact summary from metrics: last 10m total funcall requests for northleaf = 3.2k, failing = 1.6k. 50% error rate. customer support ticket shows multiple stuck sessions and timeouts. no evidence of data exfiltration. severity: P1 customer-facing degradation.

mike: rollback sounds safe. alternative short-term: enable lenient parsing flag so parser tolerates truncated pages until we revert. would prefer to do lenient flag + canary rollback.

jess: rolling a targeted rollback to parser v2.3.0 on northleaf dedicated pool now. command: ```bash
# update routing to send northleaf to parser:legacy
curl -X POST \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  https://control-plane.redwood.internal/v1/routing/update \
  -d '{"tenant":"northleaf","route":"parser-legacy","weight":1.0}'
```

jess: also applying lenient shim just in case: ```yaml
# kubectl patch deployment northleaf-parser -n vpc-northleaf \
# set env PARSER_ALLOW_TRAILING=true
- op: add
  path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-
  value: {"name":"PARSER_ALLOW_TRAILING","value":"true"}
```

deploy-bot: Deployment northleaf-parser rollback to v2.3.0 started by jess at 1719004445.

jess: rollback completed, traffic flipped at 1719004480. parser v2.3.0 serving northleaf. applied lenient shim concurrently.

incident-bot: Automated checks: error rate dropped to 0.06 (5m) after rollback. Monitoring for regressions.

sara: great. jess — please coordinate with support/product for customer-facing note. product-liz, can you prepare a short blurb for Northleaf support? include ETA: full verification in 30m.

product-liz: on it. drafting message now. want me to offer temporary bypass guidance for their engineers?

sara: yes, include a recommended client-side debounce and retry (backoff) while we stabilize. also ask them to avoid messages with embedded delimiter strings until we ship a permanent fix.

mike: post-incident actions I propose: 1) add integration test that fuzzes paging delimiters against real-world messages 2) add a canary for parser config changes scoped to a tiny set of tenants 3) instrument per-tenant parser-deploy rollback automation.

jess: filing follow-ups: INC-2026-1145 created for postmortem and action items. I'll own the canary rollout work.

sara: handing this over to eng-runtime for follow-up/monitoring. alex — you're on overnight watch for this tenant. please keep an eye on parse errors and KV cache paging metrics.

alex: acknowledged. I'll keep the dashboards open and set a alert to page me if parse_error_rate > 0.1 for > 5m. also will grab logs and save to S3 path: s3://redwood-incident-archives/INC-2026-1145/northleaf/

sara: quick checklist before we close the thread: 
- rollback success ✅
- lenient shim in place ✅
- customer notified (draft) ✅
- postmortem ticket created ✅
- owner for follow-ups: jess ✅

sara: wrapping up handoff — if anything spikes, re-open this thread or page eng-oncall. thanks all for fast coordination :thumbsup:
